result.Method of Attack: Deploys destructive data-wiping code that recursively deletes files using 'rm -rf *' command; contains a kill switch excluding Indonesian phone numbers; dormant data exfiltration function to steal phone number, device ID, status, and hardcoded key (commented out)
result.Impacted Systems: Developer computers using WhatsApp developer libraries
result.Attack Vector: Malicious npm packages masquerading as WhatsApp socket libraries
result.Indicators of Compromise: Base64 JSON file retrieved from GitHub containing kill switch phone numbers; package publisher 'nayflore'; package names: naya-flore, nvlore-hsc
